references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species shape: lean spindly humanoid-spider hybrid, long clawed reaching arms, light flowing robe over dark chitin.
Existing shipped catalog spiderkin (Ungolë): round-bodied eight-legged true spider, red eyes. Both xhaiak and shiaak must stay clearly humanoid-hybrid, not round-spider, to avoid this silhouette.

prompt_fields.subject: A lean, spindly humanoid spider hybrid crouched forward on four clawed articulated legs merging seamlessly into a slender humanoid torso and two long clawed arms; a light flowing robe drapes over one shoulder and hip, leaving chitinous black-and-charcoal segmented skin visible beneath. Small dark spider markings speckle its bare skin.
prompt_fields.contrast: First xhaiak identity and first of two new spiderkin subtypes in this batch (shiaak ships alongside it). Must read as a clearly different silhouette from the existing spiderkin entry Ungole (a squat round eight-legged true-spider body with a compact bulbous abdomen) -- xhaiak is upright, humanoid-torsoed and spindly-legged, not round-bodied. It must also differ from shiaak venomblade, shipping in the same batch: xhaiak is lean, elongated, crouched low with long reaching clawed arms and a visible robe, while shiaak is a squat, bulky, densely covered mass with two held daggers and no robe. Silhouette (spindly reaching vs. squat bulky) and value (charcoal/black chitin vs. shiaak's mottled dark-green) are the anchors.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Base-plate discipline, calibrated from monster-batch-d/monster-batch-e on this same style reference: an initial 8-unit-darker disc instruction overshot to base_drift -9 to -15 on several fresh generations, while a follow-up 4-unit-darker instruction landed cleanly inside the +-8 tolerance on a controlled retest (-5.11). Render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band -- only about 4 RGB luminance units darker than the style reference's disc appears at first read: a small, conservative undershoot, not a full shade darker. Do not darken the creature itself to compensate -- only the disc plate takes this small intentional downward bias. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Charcoal-black chitinous skin with a faint cool blue-grey sheen along leg joints and claws, one pale grey-cream flowing robe panel draped loosely across shoulder and hip for a value break against the dark body, small darker-black spider markings on visible skin; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's body so the two never merge.
